text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking by the central
plaza...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, lil' buddy! There's no need to be
scared! If
you come out, I'll give ya a big
ol' hug!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And I'll give you some dried sardines
that will
bless you with great fortune if
you can eat them
in one bite!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... We're not making much progress,
are we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there. We're looking for a
calico cat
with a red collar. Have you
seen one around?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Aw, that's a shame... The thing is,
someone who
lives around here stopped
by earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They think their pet cat might have
wandered
onto our campus and gotten
lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, are you sure? Thank you for
being so
kind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to split up to better cover
more
ground.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Meat is life! Everything's nice and grilled
up for
ya, so c'mon out, ya hungry kitty!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Woiya... haiya... Mewity meowsies, show
me the
toe bean tracksies!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eureka! "The lost cat can be found in the
east!" To
the east I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the others employ their own
tactics to find
the cat, I decide to return
to the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you again. Are you well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, I figured the best way to discover
where a
cat might be hiding is to
become like a cat. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but of course. The cat isn't used to
this
environment, so she's probably
feeling terribly
anxious.
choice_data_list: 安心できる場所にいるかも……？
楽しい場所にいるかも……？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's search for places that are likely to
make a
cat feel safe. We're one step
closer to finding
her! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Exactly what kind of place would a cat
feel safe
in, though?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright falls into deep thought
again. I
decide to continue searching on
my own,
periodically returning to check
on her progress.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely. For all we know, the cat
might be in a
wonderfully playful mood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The academy has all types of facilities. It
must
feel like an amusement park to the
little feline.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If the academy were an amusement
park... Oh! I
just had an idea. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I should try to remember how I felt the
first time
my father took me to his
amusement park so I can
really get into
the right mindset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright falls into deep thought
again. I
decide to continue searching on
my own,
periodically returning to check
on her progress.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, butter me an' call me a biscuit. I
figured one
whiff o' this juicy slab o'
meat would send a
hungry kitten
scamperin' out here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe my pawprint dowsing took
me in
circles...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's starting to get dark. I think we
should head
back to the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! Look who it is over there!
Howdy, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki! Shhhh! Look at who's sitting by
Bright's
feet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Just where could the little kitty
have
gone?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Mew! Purr, purr...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We all look, and right at Mejiro Bright's
feet is a
calico cat with a red collar,
rolling about happily
on its back!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There's no mistaking it! That's got to be
the cat
we've been searching for! Bright
seems
completely oblivious to its
presence, though...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's try to catch her attention
with hand
gestures so we don't frighten
the lil' kitty!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Is that Fukukitaru and Taiki
over there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And they're waving at me. Hehe, hello
again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How strange... They're gesticulating
quite
enthusiastically for a simple
greeting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe they're not saying hello
but
gesturing something at me? They
want me... to
look down?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meooow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh myyy. If it isn't a little kitty. ♪ Good
day to
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. And you're a calico. That red
collar of
yours really suits you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A red collar... on a calico cat...
Where have
I heard that description
before?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Stretch...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my. I just remembered. I've been
looking for
you.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Step, step, step, step.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I should pick her up so I can bring her
back to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where did she go?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bright! The cat is getting away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We gotta chase after her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of them dash after the fleeing
cat and
thankfully capture it!
